item.title: Three Days Before Christmas
item.description: "48 Hours" Live to Tell: Two sisters who survive a deadly home invasion share their journey to hell and back.

item.title: Rondale Moore, Minnesota Vikings wide receiver, dies at age 25
item.description: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Rondale Moore was found dead at the age of 25 at a residence in New Albany, Indiana, authorities reported Saturday.

item.title: DHS suspending TSA PreCheck, Global Entry programs amid partial shutdown
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem said in a statement that TSA and Customs and Border Protection "are prioritizing the general traveling population at our airports and ports of entry and suspending courtesy and special privilege escorts."

item.title: Cell phone app, security video critical in helping solve teen's murder
item.description: In April 2024, college student Sade Robinson, 19, went on a first date and never came home. Her car was found set on fire 3 miles from her apartment. Using data from an app on her phone, law enforcement began to piece together where she went — and who she was with.

item.title: 2/21: CBS Weekend News
item.description: New winter snowstorm threatens millions along East Coast; As nursing homes face staffing crisis, robots help workers focus on care

item.title: Cati Blauvelt: Death of a Soldier's Wife
item.description: A soldier goes on the run after his wife is murdered. With him, his 17-year-old girlfriend. What does she know? "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

item.title: Soldier goes on the run with teen after his wife's murder. Is she in danger?
item.description: After Cati Blauvelt, 22, was murdered in Simpsonville, South Carolina, her husband, former U.S. Army recruiter John Blauvelt, fled with his 17-year-old girlfriend Hannah Thompson. U.S. Marshals led the cross-country chase for the armed fugitive.

item.title: Sade Robinson and The Secret Beach
item.description: A teenage girl goes missing. Will evidence on a secluded beach reveal what happened? "48 Hours" correspondent Anne-Marie Green reports.

item.title: "48 Hours" show schedule
item.description: True crime. Real justice. To miss it would be a crime.

item.title: How the seat position in a murdered teen's car linked to her killer
item.description: Sade Robinson, 19, disappeared after a first date. Milwaukee investigators say clues in her car pointed to her assailant.
